Definition: Row identifier. The letter groups rows by layer: I ingestion, N index, Q query, O operations, X considered and not used.
The stack layer the row's component belongs to. Closed set: Ingestion layer, Index layer, Query layer, Operations, Considered and not used.

Whether the component carries over. Closed set: Reuse (exists and runs today), Adapt (the mechanism exists and this system supplies the content), Build (new for this system), Excluded by design (deliberately not taken).
The name this fixture gives the component, method, or approach.
What the component does inside the system, in the fixture's own terms.
The reason the component was selected, or for an X row, the reason it was not. Every cell states its strength with a core §5.6 phrase.
The part of the system the component runs in.
The runtime the component is deployed on. Every value is a design intention, not a deployed fact, because nothing in this fixture has been built.
Caveats and cross-row references. Most rows carry no note, because nothing qualifies them beyond what column C8 already states for every row.
A lookup structure that maps each term to the list of documents containing it.
The pipeline stage that receives documents and prepares them for indexing.
A component that converts varied text into one canonical form.
One agreed way of writing text, chosen so that two inputs meaning the same thing are stored identically.
The point where one text unit ends and the next begins, such as the edge between two words.
A mapping of equivalent terms, applied when a query is expanded.
A service that stores files durably by name, without a filesystem hierarchy.
A saved copy of the index at one point in time, kept so the index can be rebuilt after loss.
The delay between a document arriving and that document becoming findable by a search.
How often a term appears in one document. A higher count is taken to mean the document is more about that term.
The group of machines that together hold the index and answer search requests.
A program packaged with its dependencies, started to do one piece of work and stopped when that work ends.
A component that turns one document format into plain text. One reader handles one format.
Reading every document in the collection to answer one search, instead of consulting an index.
